questions.q: What are the four stages a Payment Process Request moves through?
options: Select, Build, Format, Confirm
Validate, Hold, Release, Pay
Intake, Triage, Investigate, Resolve
Draft, Final, Transfer, Post
questions.explain: A PPR moves through Select (gather eligible invoices), Build (construct payment documents), Format (produce the bank file), and Confirm (finalize the payment).

questions.q: What does a 'Failed Document Validation' status specifically indicate?
options: The payment file was rejected by the bank after sending
The invoices were never selected into the batch
A Build-stage failure — invoices were selected, but a valid payment document couldn't be constructed for at least one of them
The period is closed
questions.explain: Failed Document Validation occurs at the Build stage, after invoices have already been successfully selected.

questions.q: What tool lets you see exactly which invoice failed Build validation and why, instead of the whole batch failing opaquely?
options: The AutoInvoice Execution Report
The Resolve Payment Validation Errors page
GL_INTERFACE
The Accounting Event Diagnostic report
questions.explain: The Resolve Payment Validation Errors page lists each invoice that failed validation along with the specific reason.

questions.q: What was the actual root cause of Keystone Rigging Supply's invoice failing Build validation?
options: The invoice amount exceeded a tolerance
The invoice was a duplicate
The period was permanently closed
The supplier site was set up for electronic payment but had no bank account on file
questions.explain: Oracle could not build an EFT payment document because the supplier site, configured for electronic payment, had no bank account entered.

questions.q: Why were 45 of the 46 invoices in the batch unaffected by this failure?
options: The failure was specific to one supplier's missing bank account, not a batch-wide problem
Oracle randomly selects which invoices to fail
The other invoices were in a different business unit
They had already been paid previously
questions.explain: Build-stage validation failures are reported per invoice; only the invoice tied to the missing bank account failed, while the rest validated correctly.
